title: Atomic energetics and NiAl surface enrichment
difficulty_reasons: Choose atomistic models and comparisons that can explain enrichment despite the starting surface composition.
Determine energy references and which aspects of bulk–surface coupling are actually distinguishable.
Decide whether the evidence supports a thermodynamic tendency, a kinetic route or only a narrower conditional claim.

data.description: Chemical identity, declared observations and physical boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Structured research records, quantitative findings and artifact links.
